title: Glass-skin serum: the two-finger test

product.name: Dewline Barrier Serum
product.one_liner: a fragrance-free hydrating serum with ceramides and 2% niacinamide

audience: women 22-35 with dry, flaky skin under makeup

presenter.description: fictional woman, late twenties, no makeup, towel on hair; generated, not based on anyone

hook.why: Names the symptom the viewer already blames on the wrong thing.

style: candid bathroom phone video, soft window light, visible pores and skin texture

shots.visual: Close-up of a fingertip dragging foundation across dry, flaky cheek; product in the mirror
shots.camera: phone propped on the sink, macro
shots.caption:
Your foundation isn't the problem.
AI-generated ad

prompt.subject: extreme close-up of a woman's cheek with dry, flaky patches, fingertip smearing beige foundation
prompt.action: the finger drags slowly, foundation catches on the flakes and pills
prompt.camera: macro, static, phone propped on a sink
prompt.lighting: soft daylight from a window to the left
prompt.negative: smooth plastic skin, airbrush, glamour lighting

shots.visual: Presenter to camera, towel on hair, holding up a flaky makeup sponge
shots.caption: dry skin + makeup = cake
shots.voiceover: Dry skin drinks the water out of your makeup, so it cakes by lunch.

prompt.subject: fictional woman in her late twenties, towel wrapped on her head, no makeup, holding a makeup sponge toward the lens
prompt.action: she talks to the camera and tilts the sponge to show dried foundation on it
prompt.camera: handheld selfie, eye level, slight sway

shots.visual: Two drops of serum pressed into the cheek with two fingers; skin goes from matte-flaky to even
shots.caption: two drops, press, don't rub
shots.voiceover: Two drops. Press it in with two fingers, don't rub. Ceramides fill the cracks, niacinamide calms the red.

prompt.subject: close-up of two fingertips pressing a clear serum into a dry cheek
prompt.action: the fingers press and lift, the serum absorbs, flaky texture softens and evens out
prompt.lighting: soft window light raking across the skin to show texture

shots.visual: Foundation applied over the treated side; split-screen with the untreated side
shots.caption: same foundation, treated vs not
shots.voiceover: Same foundation, same sponge. Left side had the serum, right side didn't.

prompt.subject: woman's face straight to camera, a makeup sponge dabbing foundation on her left cheek
prompt.action: sponge dabs across the cheek, the foundation lays down smooth on the left, patchy on the right
prompt.camera: static, straight on, phone on a tripod

shots.visual: Ingredient label held to camera, finger tapping the ceramide and niacinamide lines; fragrance line crossed out
shots.caption: fragrance-free, ceramides, 2% niacinamide
shots.voiceover: Fragrance-free, three ceramides, two percent niacinamide. It's all on the label, no mystery blend.

shots.visual: Presenter sets the bottle on the sink edge, taps the screen toward the shop link
shots.caption: link below. try it under your usual base
shots.voiceover: Link's below. Try it under your usual base for a week.

prompt.subject: the same fictional woman, towel on head, placing a small frosted glass bottle on the sink edge
prompt.action: she sets the bottle down, looks at the lens and points down toward the bottom of the frame

claims.evidence: product label and INCI list, checked against the supplier spec sheet before filming
same INCI list; percentage printed on the label

cta.text: Link's below. Try it under your usual base for a week.
cta.on_screen: link below. try it under your usual base

notes: Presenter is fictional and generated; the script never describes her as a customer.
No skin-condition or medical wording (no 'treats eczema', no 'dermatologist-approved') without a documented source.
Split-screen in shot 4 is a demo of application, not a before/after result claim; caption says so.
